acceptanceCriteria: Sweep runs the bounded identity probe on guarded members and quarantines on drift, with a test.
Replay of confirm-safe is shown not to rerun the identity command (or its rerun is specified), with a test.
body: PR #1061 (PSR-V0-081..086) makes member identity and safeReuse mutually exclusive, so `pool sweep` never meets an identity-guarded member and never probes identity. Whether a replayed confirm-safe reruns the identity command is NOT_OBSERVED.
title: pool sweep: probe member identity when identity and safeReuse coexist (V1-1586 residual)
